title: Cloud platform & infrastructure budget allocation
transcript:
Platform Engineering Lead: I've been looking at the cost analysis for Azure and Google Cloud Platform. They just don't stack up against AWS in the near term, especially when it comes to immediate needs.

SRE: Agreed. AWS's feature set is more aligned with our current and future requirements.

Finance Partner: But what about long-term maintenance costs? Are we committed to going all-in with AWS?

CTO: Not necessarily. We're considering a hybrid approach for critical data. This will help mitigate the risk of over-reliance on a single cloud provider.

Platform Engineering Lead: I still have concerns about vendor lock-in with AWS, but if we can address that, I'm on board with a hybrid approach.

Finance Partner: What about our current data center? I've seen some numbers on data transfer costs.

SRE: We need to run a final analysis on that. But I do think the short-term savings we'll achieve with AWS will allow us to address any integration concerns that arise.

CTO: Agreed. Let's assume AWS as our primary cloud provider with a hybrid approach for critical data. SRE, you'll own this.

Platform Engineering Lead: Just remember, I'll need some assurances about vendor lock-in before I fully commit.

SRE: Understood. I'll work closely with the team to ensure a seamless transition, targeting completion by October 1.

(Off-topic exchange)

Platform Engineering Lead: Did you hear about the new coffee shop that opened down the street? I've been meaning to check it out.

CTO: Haven't had the chance yet, but I'll add it to my list.

(Returning to the topic)

Finance Partner: Alright, as long as we address your concerns about vendor lock-in, Platform Engineering Lead, I'm good with AWS.

CTO: Great. I'll work with SRE to ensure a smooth transition and sign off on the decision once we've addressed all concerns.

SRE: Sounds good to me. Let's get to work.

Title: Cloud Provider Decision and Next Steps

Decision: Adoption of AWS as the primary cloud provider, with a hybrid approach for critical data, due to its more attractive cost structure and robust feature set that aligns with immediate needs. A short-term savings plan will be implemented to address any integration concerns and address costs associated with the transfer from the current data center.

Responsibilities: The CTO will lead a seamless transition in partnership with SRE. Final analysis of AWS transfer costs will be completed before proceeding.

Notes: A hybrid approach has been chosen to mitigate potential risks associated with over-reliance on a single cloud provider. Other options, such as Google Cloud Platform and dedicated on-premises infrastructure, were considered but deemed less suitable at this time due to various factors. Long-term considerations and potential vendor lock-in issues will be addressed as part of the transition process. Target completion date: October 1.
